recipes.finish-cloud.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
key="$1"
foreground="$2"
width="$3"
height="$4"
output="$5"
# Recover only the generated magenta backdrop. No blur or synthetic watercolor mask.
# The key contributes equal red/blue excess over green. Native lavender has no excess.
convert "$key" -alpha on \
  -channel A -fx 'max(0,min(1,1-max(0,min(r,b)-g)))' \
  -channel R -fx 'a>0.003 ? max(0,min(1,(r-(1-a))/a)) : 0' \
  -channel G -fx 'a>0.003 ? max(0,min(1,g/a)) : 0' \
  -channel B -fx 'a>0.003 ? max(0,min(1,(b-(1-a))/a)) : 0' \
  -channel A -fx 'max(0,min(1,(a-0.25)/0.75))' \
  +channel -resize "${width}x${height}" -gravity center -background none \
  -extent "${width}x${height}" "${output}-cloud.png"
# Original foreground is already on its unchanged source canvas, copied at +0+0.
convert "${output}-cloud.png" "$foreground" -alpha on -channel RGBA \
  -fx 'u[1].a>0 ? u[1] : u[0]' +channel \
  -define webp:lossless=true "${output}.webp"
recipes.finish-white-cloud.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
key="$1"
foreground="$2"
output="$3"
padding="${4:-0}"
cloud_width=$((957 - 2 * padding))
cloud_height=$((532 - 2 * padding))
# A neutral white key is safe for a cloud-only source. Recover coverage from
# the requested single dark pigment's red level (53/255), then unmix white.
convert "$key" -alpha on -channel A -fx 'max(0,min(1,(1-min(r,min(g,b)))/(1-53/255)))' \
  -channel RGB -fx 'a>0.003 ? max(0,min(1,(u-(1-a))/a)) : 0' \
  -channel A -fx 'max(0,min(1,(a-0.10)/0.90))' +channel \
  -background none -resize "${cloud_width}x${cloud_height}" -gravity center -extent 957x532 "${output}-cloud.png"
convert "${output}-cloud.png" "$foreground" -alpha on -channel RGBA \
  -fx 'u[1].a>0 ? u[1] : u[0]' +channel -define webp:lossless=true "${output}.webp"
recipes.foreground/extract-foreground.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Run from the repository root. This preserves original foreground pixels only.
# All watercolor pixels in the final background must come from imagegen.
foreground_output=.tmp/illustration-sources/blurb-repair-2026-09-09/foreground
mkdir -p "$foreground_output"
for illustration in home-stuck home-step-3; do
  source_image=".tmp/illustration-sources/blurb-repair-2026-09-09/anchors/$illustration.webp"
  convert "$source_image" \
    -background white -alpha remove -alpha off \
    -fx 'max(r,max(g,b))<0.45?1:0' -colorspace Gray \
    -morphology Close Disk:1 \
    -write "$foreground_output/$illustration-ink-mask.png" \
    -bordercolor black -border 1 -fill white \
    -draw 'color 0,0 floodfill' -negate -shave 1x1 \
    "$foreground_output/$illustration-holes-mask.png"
  convert "$foreground_output/$illustration-ink-mask.png" \
    "$foreground_output/$illustration-holes-mask.png" \
    -evaluate-sequence max -morphology Dilate Disk:1 \
    "$foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png"
  convert "$source_image" \
    \( "$source_image" -alpha extract \
      "$foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png" \
      -compose Multiply -composite \) \
    -alpha off -compose CopyOpacity -composite \
    "$foreground_output/$illustration-foreground.png"
  convert "$foreground_output/$illustration-foreground.png" \
    -background '#ff00ff' -alpha remove -alpha off \
    "$foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-magenta.png"
done
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

dark_foreground_output=.tmp/illustration-sources/blurb-repair-2026-09-09/foreground-dark
dark_anchor_input=.tmp/illustration-sources/blurb-repair-2026-09-09/anchors
mkdir -p "$dark_foreground_output"

for illustration in home-stuck-dark home-step-2-dark home-step-3-dark course-learning-dark; do
  ink_threshold=0.10
  if [[ "$illustration" == course-learning-dark ]]; then ink_threshold=0.20; fi
  source_image="$dark_anchor_input/$illustration.webp"
  convert "$source_image" \
    -fx "(a>0 && (max(r,max(g,b))<$ink_threshold || (g>r*1.4 && g>=b*0.95 && g>0.12)))?1:0" \
    -alpha off -colorspace Gray -morphology Close Disk:1 \
    -write "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-ink-mask.png" \
    -bordercolor black -border 1 -fill white \
    -draw 'color 0,0 floodfill' -negate -shave 1x1 \
    "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-holes-mask.png"
  convert "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-ink-mask.png" \
    "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-holes-mask.png" \
    -evaluate-sequence max -morphology Dilate Disk:1 \
    "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png"
  if [[ "$illustration" == home-step-3-dark ]]; then
    # Broad ROIs exclude damaged dark source-cloud pixels. Final foreground
    # geometry remains selected exclusively from this target's own dark ink.
    convert -size 957x532 xc:black -fill white \
      -draw 'rectangle 289,76 765,311 rectangle 50,172 473,482 rectangle 721,160 928,460 polygon 801,446 816,449 802,526 796,531 752,531 752,514 787,514 polygon 857,446 877,446 892,514 928,514 928,531 873,531' \
      -fill black -draw 'rectangle 52,439 56,443 rectangle 62,459 66,463 rectangle 0,529 956,531' \
      -threshold 50% \
      "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-semantic-roi.png"
    convert "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png" \
      "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-semantic-roi.png" \
      -compose Multiply -composite \
      "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png"
  fi
  if [[ "$illustration" == home-step-3-dark || "$illustration" == course-learning-dark ]]; then
    # These two anchors have detached source-cloud ink-colored debris. Their
    # actual foregrounds are large connected shapes, with no detached props.
    convert "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png" \
      -threshold 50% -define connected-components:area-threshold=100 \
      -define connected-components:mean-color=true -connected-components 8 \
      -threshold 50% "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png"
  fi
  convert "$source_image" \
    \( "$source_image" -alpha extract \
      "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-mask.png" \
      -compose Multiply -composite \) \
    -alpha off -compose CopyOpacity -composite \
    "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground.png"
  convert "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground.png" \
    -background '#ff00ff' -alpha remove -alpha off \
    "$dark_foreground_output/$illustration-foreground-magenta.png"
done

limitations: Generation is not deterministic. Key removal estimates coverage. Foreground masks protect source drawing only; no watercolor alpha is borrowed across assets or blurred locally. Full cloud canvases are proportionally normalized with transparent padding; original foregrounds retain their exact canvas coordinates. These historical repairs replaced whole clouds rather than preserving their interior texture. The light recipe remaps alpha with a 0.25 cutoff, which discards faint pigment and can harden the fade. The current workflow instead edits complete illustrations against saturated chroma and restricts border-only replacements to a target-specific border band; this record does not establish acceptance of any later output.
